title: Vanderbilt researchers develop comprehensive guide for how the brain’s wiring changes with age
summary: Coverage of the Nature study mapping growth and aging across 72 white matter pathways, with reference charts spanning birth to age 100.

title: Vanderbilt researchers at forefront of global collaboration that advances preclinical imaging with diffusion MRI
summary: An international group of 58 scientists developed a three-part guide to preclinical diffusion MRI, covering acquisition, processing, microscopy comparisons, and tractography.

title: VUMC scientists record powerful signal in the brain’s white matter
summary: Researchers detected task-related BOLD signal changes throughout white matter, highlighting signals often omitted from functional MRI analyses.

title: Q&A with Dr Kurt Schilling and Dr Bennett A. Landman
summary: Schilling and Landman discuss HARFI, which uses local directional information in white matter BOLD signals to study functional connectivity.
